books.name: Yona
books.long: Yona

books.name: Matiuna Yesusmoa.
books.long: Matiu Yesusmomba Novol Vewol Vinna Owalm Yutanindm.

books.name: Makna Yesusmoa.
books.long: Makna Yesusmoa. Yesusva Nengthal Lohv, Sesoana Moalamangva Kuvuwulluhv.

books.name: Lukna Yesusmoa
books.long: Lukna Yesusmoa Lukva Yutanindna Meisungundmba Yesusmomba Novol Vewol Vinna.

books.name: Yonna Yesusmoa.
books.long: Yonna Yesusmoa. Yonmba Ishomnavna Yesusm, Sesoana Ombolm.

books.name: Aposel
books.long: Aposel Moalamangnindna Andra, Yesusna Nemelmom Hoanavho Vrulangalm.

books.name: Rom
books.long: Rom Sesoanamba Nengavnangva Lohvna, Osm Lopshalm Pim.

books.name: 1 Korin
books.long: 1 Korin Polna Mimirini Tombaimoa, Korinnindm Kolvrowolalm Kristusnindm, Noinda Ambo Sahonam Avnam Hev.

books.name: 2 Korin
books.long: 2 Korin Polva Moamba Ambara Levraholothunna, Andrava Sesoava Daswolna Moalamangnindm.

books.name: Galesia
books.long: Galesia Monamba Mongasal Lohv, Osmba Sesoava Pimba Nengsmoa Ovra, Indhana Windel.

books.name: Evesus
books.long: Evesus Sesoava Moakot Vev Hevtindimba Kristusinda.

books.name: Vilipai
books.long: Vilipai Yeoa Monglamoa Kolvrowol Vivm Losnamona.

books.name: Kolosi
books.long: Kolosi Kristusangas Pimba Lopshav.

books.name: 1 Tesalonaika
books.long: 1 Tesalonaika Polva Numhowol Vevna Kristusnindm Nemelm.

books.name: 2 Tesalonaika
books.long: 2 Tesalonaika Tesalonaikanindva Puerati Vriv, Mendeklina Prolmba Mendah.

books.name: 1 Timoti
books.long: 1 Timoti Polva Timotimba Omnana, Yeoa Wohkek Vetho Kristusna Nemelmomoa, wo Indhanam Nona Numhowol Vevm.

books.name: 2 Timoti
books.long: 2 Timoti Polva Timotimba Omnana, Kamba Doa Murapeta Dahalm Vev, Hona Andrava Si Kava Yena Englisra Holothovav.

books.name: Titus
books.long: Titus Polva Wulavna Titusmba, Kristusnindna Kuwulm.

books.name: Vilemon
books.long: Vilemon Ombandhana Andranindriniva Henga Doa Kristusnindtov Selthoana Buimera, Onesimusva.

books.name: Hipru
books.long: Hipru Honi Tombaiva Geinna Hiprunindmba, Sesoava Ishovna Ombolnashara.

books.name: Yems
books.long: Yems Tombaiva Yems Novol Vena, Osm Os Ao Kristusnindilmoa.

books.name: 1 Pita
books.long: 1 Pita Memba Mimirini Tombaiva, Pita Novol Venam, Pepeisha Vewolalm Kristusnindm, Nomba Temba Kinmba Iangavnamba.

books.name: 2 Pita
books.long: 2 Pita Mongo Henga Pitana Tombai, Yeoa Sishona Vewol Viu Moangakalamomoa.

books.name: 1 Yon
books.long: 1 Yon Yon Moalamangnindrini Unna, Yeoa Und Avramana Vevm Pevna Mongawa Kristusnindmoa.

books.name: 2 Yon
books.long: 2 Yon Manam Yimba Kolvrowol Vivra Gurudaspolmba.

books.name: 3 Yon
books.long: 3 Yon Yeoa Koldumbvm Nomoa Kristusnindmoa, Himba Temba Numhowol Vivrava Moanonoanamba.

books.name: Yut
books.long: Yut Yeoa Ahnam Dembhanga Vinvm No Hindna Moamoa, Himba Temba Ungundalmba Lovahvpa Besal Nemelmonamba.

books.name: Poaitamoa Komandhalohvna.
books.long: Poaitamoa Komandhalohvna. Poaitamoa Komandhalohvna, Kristus Hev Vraohna Yonmba.
